deviations.missing_expression: A Twister player would miss the kit's signature geometry: SELF-PROPELLED vortices that WANDER erratically across the room at 7.5m/s for 3 seconds, blinding and grinding everything they pass through, spawned in bunches by consuming a stationary whirlwind you must cast from inside.
deviations.source_anchor: A Twister player would miss the kit's signature geometry: SELF-PROPELLED vortices that WANDER erratically across the room at 7.5m/s for 3 seconds, blinding and grinding everything they pass through, spawned in bunches by consuming a stationary whirlwind you must cast from inside. The engine's multi_projectile + an R-M8 wander-note + a GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION door approximate 'many moving hits that spread', but there is no first-class 'autonomous roaming persistent AoE that pathfinds forward' member -- the erratic-wander identity (the whole reason the build feels alive) degrades to a projectile spread with a mobility note, and the 'cast-from-inside-the-whirlwind-or-lose-the-buff' positional dance compresses to an activation-toggle. What survives (a physical caster laying down multi-hit blinding area) is recognizable but hollow of the wandering-tornado fantasy -> APPROX (that build, meaningfully flatter); the roaming behavior is a documented R-M8 delta + a qualitative candidate for steward review (roaming-persistent-AoE class), not a wholly unmodelable loop, so APPROX not GAPPED.

geometry_bands.source_anchor: 0.5m-radius vortices that move forward ERRATICALLY at 7.5m/s for 3s, Blinding and repeatedly Hitting enemies within; consumes whirlwinds to spawn ADDITIONAL twisters (multi-point via several wandering twisters) -> multi_projectile (discrete self-propelled moving hazards, mirrors the poe1-spark/blade-vortex discrete-projectile lineage; multiple bouncing/wandering twisters = a projectile spread that persists and roams). Physical -> element-neutral (physical rule; elem_raw=physical). ailment=blind (fetched verbatim: 'Blinding... enemies within' -- accuracy-tax). R-M8: the erratic forward wander is a PURSUIT-adjacent behavioral delta (mobile AoE), noted.

creates a STATIONARY whirlwind zone that empowers Twister when cast from inside it -> whirlwind (spin-to-win phrase-book; here a placed spin-zone). Physical -> element-neutral. Cast Twister while inside for the empower bonus; leaving before casting collapses the whirlwind and loses the bonus. This is the SETUP for Twister (secondary stage per 7.2; Twister is the every-3-seconds damage).

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: GX-09 (corpus gx). Twister -> multi_projectile (discrete self-propelled roaming hazards; the poe1-spark/blade-vortex precedent for discrete-moving-projectiles governs -- multiple wandering twisters that bounce/roam = a persistent projectile spread, NOT vortex_pull which is a pull/vacuum, and NOT a single whirlwind since there are MANY moving twisters). R-M8 APPLIED: the erratic 7.5m/s forward wander is a mobile-AoE pursuit-adjacent behavioral delta -> noted (not a mint; the roaming is delivery flavor on top of the projectile). blind ailment kept (fetched verbatim 'Blinding'). Whirling Slash -> whirlwind (stationary spin-zone). Physical -> element-neutral (physical rule) -- Spirit Walker uses SPIRIT as a reservation/combat resource (reservation_resource=spirit, poe2-Spirit false-friend, NOT spirit-guide). Empower-if-cast-from-inside -> activation-toggle persistent_condition + apply-mark trigger. GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION routes the whirlwind-consumed->extra-twisters spread; ZONE_CONTROL routes the roaming-hazard area denial. Spirit Walker (Huntress) ascendancy -> t4 via 5 (R-M1). eras 0.2-0.5 CONFIRMED.
mapping_json.motion_frame: Whirling Slash x3 to lay a stationary whirlwind, then cast Twister from INSIDE it (empowered) -- wandering 0.5m vortices roam at 7.5m/s for 3s, blinding and multi-hitting; exit the whirlwind before Twister collapses the empowerment. Bear companion soaks.
